interfaces.description: Network interfaces to bind the UPnP server to (e.g., eth0, wlan0).

network_address.description: Explicit network address for the server (e.g., 192.168.1.10). Leave blank to auto-discover.

port.description: HTTP port used by the UPnP server for control and media traffic.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name of the DLNA/UPnP server (shown to clients).

media_dir.description: Directories containing media files. Format: 'A,path' (A=audio, V=video, P=pictures), or just 'path' to auto-detect.

items.description: Media directory with optional type prefix (e.g., 'A,/home/user/music' or '/home/user/videos')

album_art_dir.description: Directory where album art files are stored. If empty, defaults to embedded art or 'AudioArt' subdirectory.

db_dir.description: Directory where the MiniDLNA database and cache files are stored.

inotify.description: Enable real-time monitoring for changes in media directories.

thumbnail_enabled.description: Enable generation of thumbnails for images and video previews.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections allowed.

model_name.description: Model name advertised in UPnP device description.

model_number.description: Model number advertised in UPnP device description.

uuid.description: Unique device identifier (UUID). Auto-generated if empty.

transcode_wma.description: Enable WMA transcoding for compatible clients.

transcode_wmv.description: Enable WMV transcoding for compatible clients.

transcode_asf.description: Enable ASF transcoding for compatible clients.

transcode_binary.description: Path to the external binary used for transcoding (e.g., ffmpeg). Required if any transcode option is enabled.

temp_dir.description: Directory to use for temporary transcoding files.

extra_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to add to responses (e.g., 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked').

ssdp_bcast.description: Enable SSDP broadcast for discovery announcements.

max_ssdp_ttl.description: Maximum age (seconds) of SSDP entries before refresh.

presentation_url.description: Include presentation URL in UPnP device description (e.g., web UI link).

album_art_names.description: Filenames to look for as album art, in order of priority.

sequential_scan.description: If enabled, scan media directories sequentially instead of in parallel (useful for slow storage).
